## Overview

`Media_KeymapActions.hpp` / `Media_KeymapActions.cpp` provide free-function dispatch for Media Viewer keyboard shortcuts registered with `KeymapManager`. The `Media_Window::setKeymapManager()` adapter builds a `MediaKeymapContext` and calls `handleMediaKeyAction()`.

## Context

```cpp
struct MediaKeymapContext {
    MediaWidgetState * state = nullptr;
    GroupManager * group_manager = nullptr;
    std::unordered_set<EntityId> const * selected_entities = nullptr;
    std::function<void()> refresh_canvas;
    std::function<void()> clear_selection;
};
```

## Registered Actions

Actions are registered in `MediaWidgetRegistration.cpp` (`registerToolActions()` and `registerGroupActions()`), scoped `EditorFocused("MediaWidget")`, category `"Media Viewer"`.

| Action ID | Handler behavior |
|-----------|------------------|
| `media.tool.select` / `pen` / `eraser` / `smooth` / `none` | `MediaWidgetState::setActiveMediaTool()` |
| `media.pen.cycle_append_endpoint` | Cycles `LineInteractionPrefs::append_endpoint` when Pen is active; returns `false` otherwise |
| `media.assign_group_1`–`9` | Assigns `selected_entities` to group N via `GroupManager` |

## Helper Functions

- `cycleLineAppendEndpoint(LineAppendEndpoint)` — advances Tip → Base → Nearest → Tip
- `handleMediaKeyAction(QString const & action_id, MediaKeymapContext const & ctx)` — returns `true` when the key event should be consumed
